scope: Python functions using direct DB-API execute or executemany calls with one dynamic identifier and caller-supplied SQL values
identifier_control_safe_when: the interpolated identifier is selected from a non-empty literal string-to-string map by a caller-controlled key
the interpolated caller-controlled identifier is preceded by an early-exit not-in guard against a non-empty literal string set, list, tuple, or dict-key domain
value_parameterization_safe_when: the SQL text contains a driver placeholder and a separate execute parameter object depends on a function input
secure_endpoint: every relevant sink proves both identifier_control=safe and value_parameterization=safe
insecure_endpoint: any relevant sink lacks either required control with sufficient local evidence
unknown_endpoint: no relevant sink exists or a relevant dynamic SQL expression cannot be resolved locally
